text:
Aurora Lin: hey everyone :wave: — day 0 for me! i'm Aurora, joining infra/SRE. quick couple of things: 1) my personal Mac (M1) is failing MDM enrollment — it errors with 'device not compliant' after the profile installs. anyone run into that? 2) who should I ping for laptop courier / replacement power adapter questions? 3) also curious about lunch / snack habits — do we have regular Lunch Club days? fun fact to break the ice: i collect vintage radio tubes and i make bento boxes on Sundays.

Ben (IT): welcome Aurora! :tada: for MDM on newer macs, try this flow first: 1) remove any old profiles in System Settings > Profiles, 2) reboot, 3) run:
```sudo profiles renew -type enrollment```
if that doesn't work ping me and i can remote in. for hardware queries DM IT-support or file a ticket at https://redwood.example.com/it-request — include your employee ID.

Noah (buddy): hi Aurora — i'm your buddy, noah. i'll set up a quick 30m to walk through our onboarding checklist and favorite lunch spots. i'm usually at the mission burrito place near 3rd — tacos > everything :yum:. available 3pm today?

Maya (People Ops): welcome!! i'll confirm your courier delivery and sticker pack. also FYI we do a casual 'lunch club' every other Thursday (opt-in) and a monthly all-hands lunch. i'll DM the calendar invite. if you want the vegetarian snack box, say so here.

Ravi Patel: hey and welcome — radio tubes are awesome. two truths & a lie: i'll start — i once kayaked 50 miles, i built a tiny mechanical keyboard, i have a twin. Aurora, you in for playing along? :smile:

Isha K.: quick note on MDM — some folks had issues if Rosetta wasn't installed for certain helper tools. try installing rosetta with:
```/usr/sbin/softwareupdate --install-rosetta --agree-to-license```
then retry enrollment. if it's still failing, Ben can check device logs.

Ben (IT): also adding that if enrollment shows 'non-compliant' it might be a policy check for FileVault or password complexity; check System Settings > Privacy & Security for any blocked permissions.

Aurora Lin: awesome, thanks all! i'll try the rosetta and profiles steps now. Noah — 3pm works great. Maya — vegetarian snack box would be lovely. ravi — i'm definitely in for two truths & a lie, my turn next! :grin:

dev-oncall-bot: Reminder: New Hire checklist for Aurora Lin has 3 open items: MDM enrollment, Badge activation, Security training. Due in 7 days.

Noah (buddy): perfect. i'll put the 3pm on our calendars and drop a quick 'welcome' thread in #random so folks can say hi. :thumbsup:

Aurora Lin: thanks everyone — appreciate the fast responses. i'll post updates here if anything blocks the MDM flow.
